facts.fact: Law 08-09 on protection of persons regarding personal data processing is named as the main law, marking 15 years since its implementation.
The CNDP organised a Data Protection Week from 27 to 31 January 2025.
The Supreme Council of the Judicial Power said courts handled 153 personal data cases in 2024, 109 of them in criminal courts with 80 decided.
The Nador first instance court convicted a person in 2024 for placing a complainant's photo and name on a student group statement without consent.

MAR.note: Nothing on public bodies sharing data.
